meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数字或品牌徽标做成一气呵成的短视频动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里已有文案或数据,想快速做出无解说的短动画
copy.tagline_en: Turn titles, stats, or logos into a short animated motion clip
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have copy or data and want a quick narration-free animated clip

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按设计驱动做一段无旁白的短动态图形,通常 10 秒内、最多约 30 秒,输出 MP4 或透明叠加层,例如动态文字、数字翻牌、图表动画等。渲染前会先问你要预览还是直接渲染。
howto.when: 当你想要一段无旁白的短动态图形(动态文字、数字翻牌、图表动画等)时由它接管;更长、带旁白或多场景的请求转给 /general-video,不确定时先走 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds short, design-led, unnarrated motion graphics — usually under 10s (up to ~30s) — such as kinetic type, stat count-up or chart hits, rendering to MP4 or a transparent overlay. It asks whether to preview or render first.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a short unnarrated motion graphic, e.g. kinetic type, stat count-up or chart animation. Longer, narrated or multi-scene requests go to /general-video; unsure → /hyperframes.
